lines.en: This chair broke this morning. Can you fix it?
lines.ko: 오늘 아침에 이 의자가 부서졌어요. 고칠 수 있어요?

lines.en: Let me see. One screw is out.
The tools are in the drawer. Which one?
Bring the hammer and two nails, please.
Here. Do you need the glue, too?
Yes. Put glue here, and I will hit the nail.
lines.ko: 네. 여기 풀을 바르면 내가 못을 박을게요.

lines.en: You repaired the table last year, too.
I did. Now this chair is strong again.
lines.ko: 그랬죠. 이제 이 의자는 다시 튼튼해요.

lines.en: Thank you. Will it be strong enough?
Yes. Sit down and try it.
Hello! Can I borrow your hammer, please?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 망치 좀 빌릴 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Sure. What do you need to fix?
My drawer broke yesterday. It does not open.
I see. Do you need nails or screws?
A few screws, please. My screws are old.
lines.ko: 나사 몇 개요. 제 나사는 낡았어요.

lines.en: Here is the hammer and a small tool box.
Thank you so much. I will bring them back tomorrow.
Take your time. Is the drawer very old?
Yes, but the wood is strong.
Good. Call me if you need help.
